Trace, implement and test: leetcode447 number of boomerangs sort

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<iostream>
#include<vector>
#include<unordered_map>
#include<algorithm>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int numberOfBoomerangs(vector<vector<int>>& points) {
        // n = points.length, n: [1, 500]
        const int n = points.size();
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            vector<int> dists(n);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
            {
                const int dx = points[j][0] - points[i][0];
                const int dy = points[j][1] - points[i][1];
                dists[j] = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            }
            sort(dists.begin(), dists.end());
            for (int k = 1; k < n; k++)
            {
                int p = 1;
                while (k < n && dists[k] == dists[k - 1])
                {
                    k++;
                    p++;
                }
                res += p * (p - 1);
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<vector<int>> points = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {2, 0}};
    auto res = sol.numberOfBoomerangs(points);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
